heading: Pine Labs share price target: MOFSL sees 72% upside in bull case - know bear case | Rationale explained
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Pine Labs shares ended higher after Motilal Oswal initiated coverage, forecasting a 72% upside in a bull case. The company is positioned to benefit from a growing digital payments ecosystem, with expected FY26-28 revenue CAGR at 24%.&nbsp;
